messages:
elaine: quick FYI 20xx-go2 sample-app replayed a POST after a 429 and created duplicate user records. observed with burst tests.

brent: ouch. which SDK version? is this Go-only?

elaine: go-sdk v0.9.2. it retries 429s with a small fixed sleep + random jitter. it also retries automatically on token refresh which replays the original body.

mike: current behavior across languages is inconsistent: python honors Retry-After, ruby reads header but caps wait at 5s, go ignores header in the transport.

elaine: repro steps in case useful: run k6 script with 200 rps, watch ~5% 429s, then some duplicate creations show up.

brent: thanks. two quick things: (1) sample-app shouldn't rely on SDK to add idempotency keys for demos unless we document it, (2) SDKs must converge: honor Retry-After, classify 429 as throttling by default, and implement exp+full jitter.

mike: agreed. small proposal for Go: if Retry-After present -> sleep until header value; else expBackoff = min(10s, 200ms * 2^attempt); delay = rand.Int63n(expBackoff) -> time.Sleep(delay). plus a maxAttempts=5.

elaine: that sounds good. also propose we add an option `AutoReplay bool` on the client config (default false) so token refresh or network retries won't blindly replay non-idempotent ops.

brent: love AutoReplay flag. default false keeps safety-first. add helper `WithIdempotencyKey()` to api client so sample apps can opt-in easily.

qa-bot: test failures detected on branch feature/retry-fixes: duplicate-detection test failing intermittently. stack: go-sdk client retries without idempotency header.

mike: i'll own Go SDK patch. plan: (A) parse Retry-After (delta-seconds or HTTP-date), (B) exp+full jitter backoff when header absent, (C) respect AutoReplay=false to avoid replaying after refresh, (D) add integration test showing duplicate suppression when Idempotency-Key present.

elaine: for server-side TTLs we should recommend per-endpoint policies in docs. suggestion: payments 24h, user-create 1h, order-create 48h depending on business need. we'll record guidance in dev docs.

brent: we also need to update sample-app READMEs and onboarding checklist: explicit note to add idempotency keys for mutating endpoints in tutorials. many new users copy sample-apps verbatim.

mike: one edge case: Retry-After header could be a date in the past if clocks skew. parser: if parsed time <= now, treat as immediate and fallback to jitter. add tests for that.

elaine: created a minimal snippet for parsing header in Go: ```go
// Parse Retry-After: seconds or HTTP-date
func parseRetryAfter(h string) time.Duration {
  if sec, err := strconv.Atoi(h); err==nil { return time.Duration(sec) * time.Second }
  if t, err := http.ParseTime(h); err==nil { d := time.Until(t); if d<0 { return 0 }; return d }
  return 0
}
```

brent: nice. add docs comment to discourage built-in optimistic replays on non-idempotent endpoints.

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1031 - "SDK retry parity + sample-app idempotency defaults" assigned to @mike and @elaine. :spiral_note_pad:

mike: i'll open PRs across go/node/python with tests. ETA for go patch: end of week.

elaine: i'll patch sample-app and update onboarding doc. will add a tiny smoke test that asserts no duplicates when idempotency header present.

brent: follow-up: instrument console to surface retry counts and duplicate-key hits as cost alerts. more visibility will reduce customer impact.

elaine: adding that to the ticket. thanks team. :thumbsup:
